shared_or_similar_visual_information: A tilted unfilled square angle marker
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It indicates that the two slanted sides at the topmost vertex are perpendicular. Right image: It indicates that the slanted straight line at B is perpendicular to the radius BP.
Rationales: Both locations use the same type of right-angle square; its placement at a triangle vertex or near a circle does not change its meaning.
